description.en:
Our digital tire inflators combine precision pressure monitoring with rapid inflation for cars, motorcycles, and bicycles. The 30mm cylinder delivers fast inflation, while the digital display shows accurate pressure in PSI, BAR, or KPA.

Features include preset pressure with auto-stop, 12000mAh battery with USB power bank function, LED emergency light, and 150PSI max pressure. The compact design fits easily in your glove box or trunk.

We provide OEM/ODM services: custom colors, branding, and packaging. MOQ 300 units, production lead time 25-35 days.
description.zh:
我们的数字充气泵将精确的压力监测与快速充气相结合，适用于汽车、摩托车和自行车。30mm气缸实现快速充气，数字显示屏以PSI、BAR或KPA显示精确压力。

功能包括预设压力自动停止、12000mAh电池带充电宝功能、LED应急灯，以及150PSI最大压力。紧凑设计轻松放入手套箱或后备箱。

我们提供OEM/ODM服务：定制颜色、品牌和包装。最小起订量300台，大货交期25-35天。

_schema_reviews.reviewBody: I am a mechanic and I use this for quick top-ups between full inflations. The digital display reads in PSI, BAR, and KPA. The auto shut-off at target pressure is reliable. The built-in LED light makes it usable in dark garages or at night.
_schema_reviews.name: Digital gauge is accurate to ±0.1 PSI — matches my professional inflator

_schema_reviews.reviewBody: At 1.8kg this is the lightest digital inflator I have owned. It fills a standard car tire from 0 to 32 PSI in about 4 minutes. The 3m power cord and 60cm hose give plenty of reach. It also works as a power bank via its USB-A port.
_schema_reviews.name: Compact digital inflator replaces my garage air compressor for daily use

_schema_reviews.reviewBody: I use this for our family car and two bicycles (Presta valve adapter included). The inflation speed is slower than a garage compressor but perfectly adequate for regular maintenance. The storage pouch keeps everything organized.
_schema_reviews.name: Reliable for both car and bicycle tires — good value for the price

description.en: The YMC6628 is a cordless portable tire inflator with a 150PSI / 10.3Bar maximum pressure, an 11.1V lithium-polymer battery (2000mAh × 3) and a digital pressure gauge that stops automatically at your target value. It doubles as a power bank with emergency LED light and pressure monitoring, charges in 2–3 hours and runs about 25 minutes per charge. CE certified, suitable for compact cars and motorcycles, with OEM/ODM colour customisation available.
description.zh: YMC6628 是一款无线便携充气泵，最高压力 150PSI / 10.3Bar，搭载 11.1V 锂聚合物电池（2000mAh × 3）与数显胎压表，达到设定胎压自动停机；同时内置移动电源与应急 LED 照明、支持胎压监测。2–3 小时充满，单次工作约 25 分钟。已通过 CE 认证，适用于轿车与摩托车，支持 OEM/ODM 颜色定制。
